/bin/zsh -lc "awk '1' .agent-wayfinder/ephemeral-ci-runner-infrastructure/evidence/E1-approved-runner-ami-parameter.md; rg -n '\\]\\(["'^)]*inputs/transient-platform-facts'"\\.md' .agent-wayfinder || true; rmdir .agent-wayfinder/ephemeral-ci-runner-infrastructure/.wayfinder-mutation-lock; printf 'lock released\\n'; terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform validate && git diff --check && git status --short"
